Features

Everything your school needs

One powerful platform to manage every aspect of your institution — from academics to administration.

Attendance Management

Track student and teacher attendance digitally. Real-time updates for parents with leave application workflow.

Fee & Billing

Automate fee collection with online payments, generate receipts, and track outstanding dues in real-time.

Exam & Grades

Create exams, enter marks, auto-calculate grades, and generate report cards with comprehensive analytics.

Transport & Bus Tracking

Manage bus routes, stops, driver assignments, and fees. Parents get live bus tracking on the mobile app.

Timetable & Scheduling

Create and manage class timetables, handle teacher substitutions, and automatically avoid scheduling conflicts.

Messaging & Notifications

Send announcements, circulars, and direct messages to parents, teachers, and staff — instantly on all devices.
